messages.content: Hello! I am your Product Manager for DocuPulse Reader. I have reviewed the discovery log from our Business Analyst. We are solving the core pain: biomedical scientists waste hours manually copying snippets across PDF research papers into disconnected text files, and struggle to format ... I have prepared the complete, grounded Product Requirement Document (PRD) adhering strictly to the handbook standard. You can review the full PRD and the stage-by-stage token and cost estimates below.

scores.evidence: Found 3 unique features. Must-have FR coverage: 2/2.
Found 6 unique ACs with 9 Given/When/Then clauses across 3 features. Vague terms present: False.
Detected 3 explicit (unhappy path) criteria across 3 features.
Non-goals table (NG-###) present with rationale and source citations.
Success metrics with numeric targets and telemetry/query measurement methods present.
Clean separation of FRs and NFRs.

scores.fix: Remove invented roles, placeholders, tech choices, and redundant sentences

scores.evidence: Timeline and budget cited with scope trade-off reasoning.
